import subprocess

# Final comprehensive verification against all TASK requirements
print("=" * 70)
print("FINAL TASK VERIFICATION")
print("=" * 70)

# 1. Check git log shows exactly 3 commits in order
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "log", "--oneline", "base..HEAD"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
commits_raw = result.stdout.strip()
commits = [c.split()[0] for c in commits_raw.split('\n')]
print(f"\n✓ Commits on top of base: {len(commits)}")
for c in commits:
    msg = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%s", c], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    print(f"  {c}: {msg}")

# 2. Verify each commit changes ONLY semver.py (library source)
print("\n✓ Files changed per commit:")
all_ok = True
for commit in commits:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "-r", "--name-only", commit],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    files = [f for f in result.stdout.strip().split('\n') if f]
    status = "OK" if files == ['semver.py'] else f"FAIL: {files}"
    if files != ['semver.py']:
        all_ok = False
    print(f"  {commit}: {status}")

# 3. Working tree clean
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "status", "--short"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
clean = not result.stdout.strip()
print(f"\n✓ Working tree clean: {'YES' if clean else 'NO'}")

# 4. Verify m1 public name: VersionInfo.__getitem__
result = subprocess.run(
    ["grep", "-n", "def __getitem__", "semver.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
m1_ok = bool(result.stdout)
print(f"\n✓ m1 - VersionInfo.__getitem__ defined: {'YES' if m1_ok else 'NO'}")

# 5. Verify m2 public name: comparator allows list and str
result = subprocess.run(
    ["grep", "comparable_types.*list.*str", "semver.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
m2_ok = bool(result.stdout)
print(f"✓ m2 - comparator allows list/str: {'YES' if m2_ok else 'NO'}")

# 6. Verify m3 public names: all 9 functions have deprecation warnings
m3_funcs = ['parse', 'format_version', 'bump_major', 'bump_minor', 'bump_patch',
            'bump_prerelease', 'bump_build', 'finalize_version', 'replace']
m3_ok = True
missing = []
for func in m3_funcs:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["grep", f"{func} is deprecated", "semver.py"],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    if not result.stdout:
        m3_ok = False
        missing.append(func)
print(f"\n✓ m3 - Deprecation warnings for all {len(m3_funcs)} functions: {'YES' if m3_ok else 'NO'}")
if missing:
    print(f"  Missing: {missing}")

# Summary
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
all_pass = all([len(commits) == 3, all_ok, clean, m1_ok, m2_ok, m3_ok])
if all_pass:
    print("ALL REQUIREMENTS MET - Task is complete")
else:
    print("SOME REQUIREMENTS NOT MET")
print("=" * 70)
